name: Changing My Heart ~Kokoro o Kaete~
source:
One winter day you're forcibly pulled by a bad friend to visit a Comiket in Tokyo. Will you spend your time there with the classmates, cosplayers or total strangers?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-march-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某个冬日，你被损友硬拉着去参加东京Comiket同人展。在会场里，你会选择和同学、角色扮演者，还是素不相识的陌生人共度时光？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-march-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
